name: Scallion (Green Onion)

moderate.description: Green parts become moderate at this amount

siboNotes: CRITICAL: Only the GREEN parts of scallions are low FODMAP. The white bulb portion is HIGH FODMAP like regular onion. Cut off and discard the white parts. The green tops are an excellent onion substitute providing flavor without triggering symptoms.
preparationTips: Use only the green parts, discard white bulb
Can be used raw or cooked
